messages:
anya-cs: Quick heads-up — MarinerRetail has a cross-border demo next Tue 14:00 UTC and needs a temporary geo-split surge + header allowlist so their partner edge can sign requests. Renewal flagged as at-risk if demo hits auth/latency issues.

rob-ops: OK. What QPS spike and which regions? Header or IPs? Any special auth pattern?

anya-cs: Product requests +3.5x baseline QPS for 4.5 hours (2026-07-12T14:00Z -> 2026-07-12T18:30Z). Primary route should be us-west-2 for US traffic and ca-central-1 for Canada-origin requests; fallback to us-east-1 only if both constrained. Header whitelist only: X-Customer-Auth with token format mariner_{UPPER+digits}. No CIDR initially, but they may add an accelerator CIDR later. Auto-revoke after window. Tag renewal_risk=high.

rachel-eng: We can implement geo-split routing by source ASN/geo header and prefer the two regions you listed. Header regex suggestion: ^mariner_[A-Z0-9]{6,10}$. Fallback model available: mariner-mini-q5_k (quantized). Recommend fallback when p95 latency > 320ms sustained for 90s or 5xx_rate > 1.2% for 2m. Also suggest ephemeral buffer pool size +20% during window to reduce tail latency.

rob-ops: I'll draft CR with auto-revoke, header pattern, geo routing, rate multiplier, ephemeral pool bump and alerting. Any additional checks for the AMs?

anya-cs: Ask AMs to collect any 401/403 counts and a short customer diary post-demo. Please surface traces for any requests that hit fallback model.

rob-ops: CR snippet: ```json
{ "customer": "mariner-retail", "change_request": "CR-2026-0712-mariner-geo-surge", "window_start": "2026-07-12T14:00:00Z", "duration": "4h30m", "rate_multiplier": 3.5, "region_policy": {"primary": ["us-west-2","ca-central-1"], "fallback": ["us-east-1"]}, "allowlist": {"header": "X-Customer-Auth", "pattern": "^mariner_[A-Z0-9]{6,10}$"}, "ephemeral_pool": "+20%", "fallback_model": "mariner-mini-q5_k", "fallback_condition": "p95_latency > 320ms for 90s OR 5xx_rate > 1.2% for 2m", "alerts": "p95>320ms OR 5xx>1.2%", "auto_revoke": true }
```

rachel-eng: LGTM. I'll stage the fallback model and add a runbook entry to capture traces when fallback triggers. Rob please attach the CR to the deployment runbook and schedule the timer.

rob-ops: Change CR-2026-0712-mariner-geo-surge created and pushed to infra. Scheduling auto-revoke at 2026-07-12T18:30:00Z.

infra-bot: Change CR-2026-0712-mariner-geo-surge applied: rate_multiplier=3.5 (primary: us-west-2, ca-central-1), header allowlist added for X-Customer-Auth with pattern ^mariner_[A-Z0-9]{6,10}$, ephemeral pool +20% allocated, fallback model mariner-mini-q5_k enabled with configured conditions, alerts configured. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-07-12T18:30:00Z.

tom-am: Noted — I'll mark the account renewal_risk=high and schedule post-demo outreach. Anya please capture customer diary, auth failure counts, and any trace IDs for fallback hits; share summary here within 24h.

anya-cs: Will do. I'll collect sample traces, auth failure numbers, and short notes from the demo and post back within 24h. :memo:
